name: Mary's | Transdermal Compound  1:1:1 | CBG 300mg:THC 300mg:CBD 300mg
description:
500:500 THC:CBDA spot-specific transdermal balm formulated to allow for much deeper penetration than traditional cannabis topicals. Features a 100mg blend of both CBD and THC.

 

1:1 (100mg CBD:100mg THC)
Onset: Immediate – 15 minutes 
Duration: 3 – 5 hours
Dosage: Apply as needed
 

Also available in 50:50mg of CBD:THC (0.5 oz).
Also available in 10:1 CBD:THC.
